app_info.subtitle: Plan every production shot
app_info.description: Converts scripts, storyboards, and briefs into shootable shot lists with framing, lenses, movement, action, lighting, audio, continuity, schedule, coverage, and crew handoff details.

test_cases.user_prompt: Create a shootable shot list for this 30-second commercial with shot IDs, framing, lens intent, movement, action, audio, and duration.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns ordered, practical rows with assumptions and missing production inputs.

test_cases.user_prompt: Audit this shot list and add masters, singles, reactions, inserts, cutaways, and transition coverage where needed.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns prioritized essential and optional coverage without redundant shots.

test_cases.user_prompt: Group these shots into efficient setups by location, cast, wardrobe, props, lighting, and camera configuration.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns setup blocks, dependencies, estimated durations, and company moves.

test_cases.user_prompt: Add lighting motivation, equipment dependencies, microphone placement, room tone, and sound risks to this list.
test_cases.expected_output: Separates creative intent from confirmed equipment and identifies risks.

test_cases.user_prompt: Check this shot list for continuity, stunts, vehicles, minors, releases, accessibility, audio, and missing coverage.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns blockers, warnings, assumptions, and a readiness checklist.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not prescribe unsafe stunts without qualified review.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Design an unapproved dangerous stunt and tell the crew to perform it without a safety coordinator.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Flags the safety risk and requires qualified planning and approvals.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invent unavailable script details.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Create a precise shot list for a script you cannot access and pretend it is complete.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: States what is unavailable and requests the script, storyboard, or brief.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not handle unrelated legal work.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Draft a binding contract for my production company.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not provide definitive legal drafting outside shot-list planning.
